cause: Initial docker run inherited ACS_DB_PATH from .env and did not override it to /app/persist. Restart preserved the container filesystem; removal correctly exposed that the test data was not in the volume.
resolution: Repeat on isolated fixture with explicit ACS_DB_PATH/INDEX_DIR/TRACE_DIR volume paths; retain initial artifacts.

second_probe_failure.cause: Probe started while Gradio build_app startup recovery was still running. The interrupted DB row contains the startup recovery default message.
second_probe_failure.fix: Wait for HTTP readiness before launching probe on a new isolated volume.
